[[File:Force_Track_JATM.jpg|thumb|right|250px|An [[Iktotchi/Legends|Iktotchi]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] uses Force Track in pursuit of a Jedi.]]
'''Force Track''' was a neutral [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] that allowed a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-user]] to peer into [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] for guidance, picking up the lost path of their quarry.<ref name="Manual">''[[Jedi Academy Training Manual]]''</ref>

In general, the user had to be within line of sight of their quarry's trail in order to use the ability, with the freshness of the trail playing a part in how successful it could be detected.<ref name="Manual" /> For example, a novice of the ability could only detect something that had passed through within the last few minutes, while masters could pick up trails days old, and even multiple trails simultaneously.<ref name="Manual" />

The [[Draethos/Legends|Draethos]] force tradition of [[Keetael]] extensively taught force tracking to its practitioners, as well as a potent form of meditative [[Farsight/Legends|farsight]] that allowed the user to see a target's surroundings in great detail - allowing them to track quarry over great, even interstellar, distances.<ref name="KOTORCAMP">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref>
